digest.component_or_area: Claude Code MCP tool configuration (Serena symbol tools)
propositions: Serena symbol tool schemas are deferred by default, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip before first use, creating friction asymmetry against cheaper alternatives like grep
ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is the only available control for deferral, is global (no per-tool or per-server setting), and affects all connected MCP servers, not just Serena
A repo-committed .claude/settings.json with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH set to false will make Serena tools resident at session start, eliminating the discovery step

The measured cost of setting ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false is +25,454 tokens minimum (Serena-only) to +63,852 tokens on a host with 4 MCP servers, justified by preventing defects that cost full-suite pre-flight failures
The change requires .gitignore negation to track .claude/settings.json while keeping the rest of .claude/ ignored, and one-line revert documentation
